**No netlist can meet the peaking spec as written, so I've left the design unchanged.**

**Why the spec is infeasible.** The simulator reports peaking relative to the passband gain. With gain_db = −6.159 and peaking = +2.9e-5 dB, it is computing max|H(f)| − |H(f_ref)|. The reference frequency is itself one of the swept points, so this number can never be below 0 dB for any filter. A limit of "≤ −5.8 dB" can therefore never be met, by this or any other topology. The violation score of exactly 1.00 also suggests the checker cannot be satisfied.

**What the target probably meant:**
- **Peaking ≤ +5.8 dB (sign error).** The current design passes easily: it is monotonic, with about 0 dB peaking.
- **An absolute gain limit of −5.8 dB.** The −6 dB input attenuator puts max|H| at −6.16 dB, which already passes.

**Status of the other specs:**

| Spec | Result | Target |
|---|---|---|
| fc | 1.496 MHz | 1.46–1.54 MHz |
| Attenuation | 53.8 dB | ≥ 43 dB |
| Power | 75.6 µW | ≤ 87.5 µW |

**What I did not do.** Any change I could make, such as adding a resonance, more attenuation or a different Q, would make the design worse under every sensible reading of the spec. It still could not produce negative relative peaking. Please confirm the intended sign or definition of the peaking metric. If it is "≤ +5.8 dB" or an absolute gain cap, the netlist below already satisfies all specs.

```spice
.subckt dut vin vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- input attenuator (-6 dB), Thevenin = 100k, DC-centred at vmid ----
RD1 vdd vmid 200k
RD2 vmid vss 200k
Ra vin na 200k
Rb na vmid 100k
* ---- 3rd-order unity-gain single-amp Sallen-Key LPF (monotonic, ~Butterworth) ----
C1 na vss 1.27p
R2 na nb 100k
C2 nb vout 3.05p
R3 nb nc 100k
C3 nc vss 0.168p
* ---- bias: IREF (into ibias) -> NMOS mirror, tail = 3x IREF ----
MB ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
MT tail ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1 m=3
* ---- 5T OTA, unity-gain follower: in+ = nc, in- = vout ----
M1 nm nc tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2 vout vout tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M3 nm nm vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5
M4 vout nm vdd vdd pfet W=4 L=0.5
.ends
```
